comment: * Interface for ChildSessionStateMachine to notify IkeSessionStateMachine of state changes.

methods.name: void onChildSaCreated(int remoteSpi, ChildSessionStateMachine childSession)
methods.comment: Notify that new Child SA is created.

methods.name: void onChildSaDeleted(int remoteSpi)
methods.comment: Notify that a Child SA is deleted.

methods.name: void scheduleRetryLocalRequest(ChildLocalRequest futureRequest)
methods.comment: Schedule retry for a Create Child Request on the LocalRequestScheduler.

methods.name: void onOutboundPayloadsReady(@ExchangeType int exchangeType, boolean isResp, List<IkePayload> payloadList, ChildSessionStateMachine childSession)
methods.comment: Notify the IKE Session to send out IKE message for this Child Session.

methods.name: void onProcedureFinished(ChildSessionStateMachine childSession)
methods.comment: Notify that a Child procedure has been finished.

methods.name: void onChildSessionClosed(ChildSessionCallback userCallbacks)
methods.comment:
* Notify the IKE Session State Machine that this Child has been fully shut down. * *

This method MUST be called after the user callbacks have been fired, and MUST always * be called before the state machine can shut down.

methods.name: void onFatalIkeSessionError(Exception exception)
methods.comment:
* Notify that a Child procedure has been finished and the IKE Session should close itself * because of a fatal error. * *

Child Session may encounter an IKE Session fatal error in three cases with different * handling rules: * * 

         * - When there is a fatal error in an inbound request, onOutboundPayloadsReady will be
         *   called first to send out an error notification, and then onFatalIkeSessionError() will
         *   be called to locally close the IKE Session.
         * - When there is a fatal error in an inbound response, onOutboundPayloadsReady will be
         *   called first to send out an IKE Delete message, and then onFatalIkeSessionError() will
         *   be called to locally close the IKE Session.
         * - When there is a fatal error notification in an inbound response,
         *   onFatalIkeSessionError() will be called to locally close the IKE Session"
         *

methodNames: void onOutboundPayloadsReady(@ExchangeType int exchangeType, boolean isResp, List<IkePayload> payloadList, ChildSessionStateMachine childSession)
